sentences.en: This artwork excited much controversy in the world of art.
sentences.zh: 这幅作品在艺术界引起了很大的争论。

sentences.en: He has a taste for controversy for its own sake.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢为了争论而争论。

sentences.en: There was a controversy about the location of the new school.
sentences.zh: 关于新学校的位置，大家意见不一。
